title: Introduction of an optimized protocol for long-read nanopore sequencing of blood group genes in immunohematology case studies
author: figshare admin karger
license_note: figshare article detail endpoint license.name: CC BY 4.0

steps.title: Design LR‑PCR primers
steps.instruction: Design long‑range PCR primers for blood group genes ACKR1, CD151, BCAM, KEL, SLC14A1, GYPA, GYPB, GYPE, RHD and RHCE, targeting amplicon sizes of 2.4–15.8 kbp.

steps.title: Extract DNA from blood
steps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from EDTA‑anticoagulated blood samples.

steps.title: Perform LR‑PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify each target gene using the designed long‑range PCR primers.

steps.title: Prepare sequencing library
steps.instruction: Prepare nanopore sequencing libraries from the LR‑PCR products.

steps.title: Load library onto MinION
steps.instruction: Load the library onto a MinION Mk1D device using FLO‑MIN114 flow cells; alternatively use Flongle FLO‑FLG114 or PromethION FLO‑PRO114 flow cells as desired.

steps.title: Run nanopore sequencing
steps.instruction: Run the nanopore sequencing on the selected device to generate long‑read data.

steps.title: Analyze data for variants
steps.instruction: Perform data analysis including variant detection and genotyping to obtain allele calls and zygosity.
